name: Widow
description: A short ring of three, with a rule underneath it holding the line.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @m3(radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 96%, #0000 96%) @plot(r: 0.52; move: 0.5 0.5) / 26% 26% no-repeat); mask: @m3(radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 96%, #0000 96%) @plot(r: 0.52; move: 0.5 0.5) / 26% 26% no-repeat); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 10%; top: 86%; width: 80%; height: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 120deg, 240deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 120deg, 240deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
